name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester). The closest bar to LAX, open since 1952.
Taco Tuesday: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas.
Join Melody Rewards free: +100 points when you join.
Earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
One reward per day and one prize per day.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Melody Approach is a free flying game. Weekly boards reset every Monday.
Game prizes and game points are in BETA and are not switched on yet.
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year.
Friend referral: +100 points per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
The app works in your phone's browser, with no download.
Melody Rewards points are separate from Nalu Vida points.
suggested: What rewards can I get and what do they cost?
How do I play Melody Approach?
What is the Just Landed deal?

qa.q: What is Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: Melody is the closest bar to LAX, in Westchester, open since 1952. This app has the menu, rewards, games and sports scores.

qa.q: What's your address?
qa.a: 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045. Tap Directions in the app for a map.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call (310) 670-1994, or tap the Call button in the app.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Hours from our website are Mon–Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat–Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Weekends open at 9 AM, per our website. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: When does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen close time. Please call (310) 670-1994 or ask staff.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Our notes say parking is free. Ask staff if you need help finding a spot.

qa.q: How far are you from LAX?
qa.a: The app says Melody is 5 minutes from LAX. Our website says it's about a 15-minute walk from the terminals.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3–6 every day.

qa.q: What are the happy hour prices?
qa.a: The app shows the happy hour times (3–6 daily) but doesn't list the prices. Please ask your server or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What is the Monday special?
qa.a: Mondays are half off burgers, 11 to 3.

qa.q: What is the Tuesday special?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday: every taco is $4, and margaritas are $6.

qa.q: Are there Thursday or Friday specials?
qa.a: Yes, Thursday and Friday have deals from 11 to 3. Ask your server for the details.

qa.q: What events do you have each week?
qa.a: Every week there's karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs. Call (310) 670-1994 for the schedule.

qa.q: When is karaoke?
qa.a: Our notes say karaoke is Wednesdays from about 10 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app also has Today's games with live LA and California scores and where to watch.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge details for every night. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is there a dress code?
qa.a: I don't have a dress code listed. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is Melody 21+ at night?
qa.a: I don't have the age policy for evenings. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you serve food?
qa.a: Yes. The app menu has Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, and Tacos & Burritos.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings $16, Avocado Toast $13, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites $15, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries $16, Chicken Pot Stickers $15, Fried Green Beans $13, Fried Shrimp $18.25, Jalapeno Calamari $16, Lettuce Wraps $16, and Baby Back Ribs & Fries $20.25.

qa.q: What mac & cheese do you have?
qa.a: House Mac $15, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25, Melody Burger Mac $19.25, and Lobster Mac & Cheese $21.50.

qa.q: What burgers do you have?
qa.a: The app lists the Melody Burger for $19.25. It's Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries.

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Melody Fries $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25, and Sweet Potato Fries $7.75. Cheese is +$2 on Melody Fries and Phat Fries.

qa.q: What soups do you have?
qa.a: French Onion, Tomato Bisque (cup $11, bowl $15) and Black Bean (cup $9.75, bowl $14).

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos come as 2 per order: Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13, Beyond $14. Burritos: Carnitas $18.25, Steak $18.25, Chicken $17.25, Bean & Cheese $14. Nachos and a Cheese Quesadilla are $15.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or plant-based options?
qa.a: The app menu has Avocado Toast, Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Bean & Cheese Burrito, Cheese Quesadilla and Fried Green Beans. Ask staff about ingredients for dietary needs.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: The app lists Mango, House and Paloma-style margaritas, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, Mimosa, shots and a bucket of 5 beers.

qa.q: How much are drinks?
qa.a: The drink prices in the app are previews and not final. Ask your server for current prices. Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. Pick your table, the bar, the patio or to go, add items, and send your order. If you scanned a table code, your table is already picked.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app doesn't take payment, but you still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What does the QR code on my table do?
qa.a: It opens the app with your table already picked, so you can browse the menu and order from your phone.

qa.q: Can I order to go?
qa.a: Yes. Choose "To go" when you pick where you're sitting. The app says you'll get a text when it's ready.

qa.q: Do I need to download the app?
qa.a: No download. It opens in your phone's browser. Use the link in our Instagram bio (@melodylax) or scan the QR on your table.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Use your browser's Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone, notifications need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: What languages is the app in?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. Look for the language option in the app.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap to become a member. It's free and takes about 10 seconds. You get a gold Melody Rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No. Joining is free, with one account per person.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: +100 points once when you join.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip. You also get bonuses for joining, your birthday, referrals and (once game rewards are on) games.

qa.q: What is the points ratio?
qa.a: 10 points for every $1 spent on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap "Add my visit" in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Points come after the check is verified.

qa.q: Are there limits on adding visits?
qa.a: One receipt per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Will points happen automatically later?
qa.a: Once Melody connects the app to its register, it becomes automatic and your points carry over.

qa.q: Do I earn points on food and drinks?
qa.a: Yes. The app says you earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases. Ask staff what's not eligible.

qa.q: Do I earn double points at happy hour?
qa.a: The app doesn't mention double points. Ask staff to check.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: a free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500 pts: a free entrée up to $21.50.

qa.q: How many points for a free soft drink or fries?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: 500 points gets you $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 1,000 points gets you a free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: How many points for a free meal?
qa.a: 1,500 points gets you a free entrée up to $21.50: Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap "Use reward" and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. Each visit gets a fresh one-time code.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date), per member and per phone. A second one shows "Come back tomorrow."

qa.q: Can I stack rewards or offers?
qa.a: No. Rewards don't stack with each other. They also have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards never include free alcohol.

qa.q: Do my points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details. The rules say points already earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff for more.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: The app doesn't show levels or tiers. You earn points and spend them on the rewards.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes, +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Your friend enters your code when they join. You get +100 points once they join and make a first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's code later?
qa.a: No. You can enter one friend's code, once, when you join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own.

qa.q: What is the nearby alerts bonus?
qa.a: Turn on nearby alerts and open the app with location and notifications on for at least 3 different days over at least 7 days. You get +100 points once.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have an early-bird bonus in the app. Ask staff about any current offers.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for leaving a review?
qa.a: Yes. The app offers +50 points once per member for telling us how we did.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play games?
qa.a: No. The games are free to play with or without an account. You need an account to save game points once rewards are on.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's our arcade flying game. You fly a plane over LA, shoot jets and bosses, dodge fire and catch Melody's food and music notes.

qa.q: How do I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap ⚡ for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

qa.q: What are the two game modes?
qa.a: Campaign is 10 levels over a real SoCal route, about 45 seconds each, ending with a landing at LAX. Survival has no finish line and just gets harder.

qa.q: How does scoring work in Melody Approach?
qa.a: Campaign is ranked by score. Survival is ranked by the longest time you survive. Catching Melody's food and shooting enemies adds to your score.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, and ammo crates refill them.

qa.q: How do I lose in Melody Approach?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down. The game is over and nothing else happens.

qa.q: Can I play without fighting?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the ⚔️ button or use Pause to turn combat off for a calm flight.

qa.q: Are there bosses?
qa.a: Yes, six boss fights in Campaign (levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10). Every boss attack is warned first.

qa.q: How often can I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free. Game points are capped per day once rewards are on.

qa.q: How do I get on the weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: Finish a flight and tap "Post my score." Practice and test flights don't go on the boards.

qa.q: When does the leaderboard reset?
qa.a: Both weekly boards (Campaign score and Survival time) reset every Monday.

qa.q: Who is the weekly champion and what do they win?
qa.a: The top Campaign score and the longest Survival time each week. When prizes switch on, the weekly prize is free Melody Fries. Right now the boards are for bragging rights only.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked or handed out?
qa.a: Prizes are BETA and not switched on yet. I don't have the date or how winners are contacted. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do I get points from games?
qa.a: Not yet. Game points are in BETA. Once on, your score earns 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: What are the Melody Games?
qa.a: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word (a daily 5-letter word), Melody Mix (word scramble) and Truth or Dare. You can play solo or pass the phone around.

qa.q: How do trivia games give points?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on, Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers, up to 5 a round.

qa.q: How does Melody Word work?
qa.a: It's one 5-letter word a day, the same for everyone. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints. Once rewards are on, solving it earns 3 points (2 with one hint, 1 with two).

qa.q: How does Melody Mix work?
qa.a: It's a word scramble. Once rewards are on, you earn 1 point per 2 words solved, up to 3.

qa.q: Is Truth or Dare for points?
qa.a: No, it's just for fun. Dares never involve drinking and anyone can pass.

qa.q: What's the daily limit for game points?
qa.a: Once rewards are on, it's at most 10 Games Pack points a day, and at most 50 game points a day overall.

qa.q: What is the LA Scoreboard?
qa.a: It shows live scores from ESPN for information only. There are no streams.

qa.q: What are "Who wins?" picks?
qa.a: Free picks, just for fun, with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. Once rewards are on, a right pick earns 2 points, up to 6 a day.

qa.q: What is Football Squares?
qa.a: Members get 1 free square per board in the app. Extra squares can be added with a purchase by showing your card. Numbers are drawn at kickoff, and winners are decided by the last digit of each team's score at the end of each quarter.

qa.q: What can I win in Football Squares?
qa.a: Prizes are set per board and shown before you play: food, merch, % off the check, a free non-alcoholic drink or a % off a drink (21+ with ID). No cash and never free alcohol.

qa.q: What is the Just Landed deal?
qa.a: Show a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours and get 10% off your first order that day. One per guest per day, and it can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Is there an airline or LAX worker discount?
qa.a: Our notes list 10% off the check, dine-in, with a badge for airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers. Ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: The app has a kid mode that hides adult-only items. Ask staff if you need more detail.

qa.q: Where is my rewards card?
qa.a: Tap "My Rewards Card" in the app. It shows your card ID, points, next reward, a QR code and this visit's code. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't available yet.

qa.q: What is Nalu Vida?
qa.a: It's our sister spot at the Venice Pier. It has its own rewards points, separate from Melody's.

qa.q: Can I use my Melody points at Nalu Vida?
qa.a: No. Each restaurant has its own balance, and points don't move between them.

qa.q: What do you collect about me?
qa.a: When you open the app it logs the time, a short device summary, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. Location is only used if you turn on nearby alerts. It's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: How do I turn off location or alerts?
qa.a: Tap "Turn off nearby alerts" in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you already earned stay.

qa.q: Who can I ask for help?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Can I host a private event?
qa.a: Our notes say Melody hosts private events for 10 to 150 guests, including a private party room with a pool table. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you deliver?
qa.a: Our notes list DoorDash for delivery, and takeout is available. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
